# `inflight_tracker`

Tracks live request counts and reserved tokens per model.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `default_model` | string | no | Model name attributed when the request body reveals none. Keeps counts from silently vanishing for clients that omit `model`. |
